plugin: NetworkService APC UPS PDU Environmental SNMP
plugin_desc: APC PowerNet UPS and Automatic Transfer Switch SNMP collection for appliances under APC PEN 318. The shared SNMP floor supplies MIB-II uptime and IF-MIB 64-bit HC interface traffic. This child template adds PowerNet UPS battery charge percent and output load percent, plus ATS selected source, input/output voltage and current, and output load percent. Shared CPU, memory, fan and power-health scalars are not claimed across APC device families.
name: NetworkService

metrics.name: network_service_apc_battery_capacity
metrics.description: Remaining PowerNet UPS battery capacity as a percent of full charge.

metrics.name: network_service_apc_output_load
metrics.description: Current PowerNet UPS output load as a percent of rated capacity.

metrics.name: network_service_apc_ats_selected_source
metrics.description: Currently selected ATS input source (atsStatusSelectedSource): 1 = source A, 2 = source B. Any other value is dropped.

metrics.name: network_service_apc_ats_input_voltage_volts
metrics.description: ATS input phase voltage in VAC (atsInputVoltage). Values outside 0-300 V and the unsupported sentinel are dropped.

metrics.name: network_service_apc_ats_input_current_amps
metrics.description: ATS input phase current in whole amperes (atsInputCurrent). Negative values and the unsupported sentinel are dropped.

metrics.name: network_service_apc_ats_output_voltage_volts
metrics.description: ATS output phase voltage in VAC (atsOutputVoltage). Values outside 0-300 V and the unsupported sentinel are dropped.

metrics.name: network_service_apc_ats_output_current_amps
metrics.description: ATS output phase current in amperes (atsOutputCurrent). The device reports tenths of an ampere; the stored value is already divided by 10. Negative values and the unsupported sentinel are dropped.

metrics.name: network_service_apc_ats_output_load_percent
metrics.description: ATS output phase load as a percent of rated capacity (atsOutputPercentLoad). Values outside 0-100 and the unsupported sentinel are dropped.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: Average inbound interface bytes per second over five minutes from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCInOctets counter.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: Average outbound interface bytes per second over five minutes from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets counter.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: Device uptime since the last restart, derived from sysUpTime.
